messages:
marta: Heads-up — SolisAI asked for a temporary throughput uplift for their EU deployment this week. They have an active peered VPC and want their CIDR ranges exempted from standard rate-limits for a short burst window. Need ENG + infra sign-off before we touch prod.

devon: How large a uplift are they asking for and what's the time window? SLA/cost constraints?

marta: They want ~3x baseline throughput for 72h starting Tue 00:00 UTC. Confirmed they'd cover cost overage. Peered ranges are 52.14.0.0/16 and 52.15.0.0/16. They want an automatic fallback to normal limits after 72h.

jay_engops: Ok. We'll need: 1) CIDR exception on EU ingress route, 2) rate-window change (larger window + burst multiplier) and 3) a scheduled revert job. I can stage the config and canary it.

marta: @jay_engops can you stage? @devon please confirm capacity reserve. I'll update the customer once we have staging plan.

devon: I can reserve one extra dedicated pool (adds ~100k tok/s) for the 72h window. Need approval code/cost center — 4487.

marta: Customer already ok with cost center 4487. They also want graceful degradation if we hit backend limits — prefer 10% canary for first 15m then ramp to 100%.

jay_engops: Plan outlined. I'll run this as a staged rollout: canary 10% for 15m -> full for remainder of window. Config I'll apply to eu-prod-ingress. Pasting staged config snippet: 

```
routes:
  - name: eu-prod-ingress
    cidr_excepts:
      - 52.14.0.0/16
      - 52.15.0.0/16
    rate_window: 180s
    max_rps: 500
    burst_multiplier: 3
    canary:
      percent: 10
      duration: 15m
    revert_after: 72h
```

jay_engops: I'll open a PR with the change, run the staging job against EU canary hosts, and schedule a revert job for 72h after start. Will tag @devon for capacity verification before full rollout.

ops-bot: deploy-bot queued: /deploy-route eu-prod-ingress (staged) — CI checks running.

devon: Capacity reserve done and tagged to 4487. I'll stand by for the PR link and will confirm once the pool is live.

marta: Great — once PR is merged I'll post the exact start time to the customer and set expectation for automatic revert. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

jay_engops: PR: https://git.internal/r/prod-routing/pulls/3421 — CI green. Scheduling canary for Tue 00:00 UTC.

marta: Copy that. I'll notify SolisAI with the canary plan and fallback notes.

devon: After canary completes I'll monitor token throughput and tails. If we see sustained errors, we'll open hotfix and revert earlier.

marta: Noted. Closing loop after 72h.
